messages:
matt_s: Heads-up — noticed a steady p99 token latency drift in eu-west-1 for short-sequence calls starting ~09:10 UTC. p95 bumped slightly, but p99 more than doubled.

jess_l: Yep saw that on the token-level dashboard. URL: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/token-slo/prefix-cache-drill?panelId=7

ravi_k: quick check: p99_by_model query I ran: 
```
quantile_over_time(0.99, histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(inference_latency_seconds_bucket{job="inference",region="eu-west-1"}[5m])) by (le, model)) [15m:5m])
```
Model=base-7b is the worst offender.

matt_s: Also correlate with prefix_cache_miss_rate metric — miss rate jumped around the same time. Could be cache eviction during scaling events.

jess_l: I pulled logs from a couple of pods. Found a burst of preemption/eviction events from the autoscaler at 09:08-09:11:
```
[2025-08-08T09:08:59Z] pod/pool-eu-23 terminated: scale-down
[2025-08-08T09:09:12Z] pod/pool-eu-45 created: pending
[2025-08-08T09:09:55Z] pod/pool-eu-45 ready
```
Cache warmup likely caused higher KV prefix misses + more CPU time to rebuild ephemeral caches.

ravi_k: Prometheus drill query I used to show cache miss correlation: 
```
series:rate(prefix_cache_misses_total{region="eu-west-1"}[5m])
```
Overlayed with tokens/sec shows the miss spike when tokens/sec was only modestly higher — i.e., not pure load, more churn.

sre-oncall: I just muted the noisy p99 alert for eu-west-1 for 15m while we investigate (AlertID: SRE-ALERT-783). Leaving p95 alert as-is.

jess_l: Proposed fix paths: 1) raise scale-down delay for pools with models that have large cold caches, 2) enable a tiny standby pool (warm nodes) for eu-west-1 model-7b, 3) tune autoscaler to prefer draining under low-traffic windows. Which do we want to try first?

matt_s: Let's do (1) and (2) in parallel. I'll file a quick runbook change to increase the node-grace-period from 300s -> 900s for pool-eu-*.

ravi_k: I'll create a Grafana drill panel that shows p50/p95/p99 + prefix_cache_miss_rate and tokens/sec side-by-side with an annotation layer for autoscaler events. Query suggestions: 
- p50/p95/p99 per model: histogram_quantile(0.5|0.95|0.99, ...) by (model)
- tokens/sec: sum(rate(inference_tokens_total[1m])) by (region)
- cache miss rate: increase(prefix_cache_misses_total[5m]) / increase(prefix_cache_lookups_total[5m])

grafana-bot: Panel created: "prefix-cache — p99 vs miss rate (eu-west-1)" (panelId=214).

matt_s: I'll deploy the node-grace change to staging first, monitor for a couple hours, then roll to prod if stable. Tagging @oncall for morning check.

sre-oncall: Acknowledged. If p99 still > 2x baseline after warm-pool, escalate to infra to consider pinned warm instances.

jess_l: Also adding a note to the SLO runbook about cache-warmup being a root cause for token-level p99 spikes. Will include recommended dashboard queries and an incident checklist.

matt_s: Thanks team. I'll post follow-up once staging results are in. :thumbsup:
